name: Infinite Horizontal Scroll
description: Full-screen cinematic horizontal scroller that loops endlessly. Wheel and touch drag move through text and image panels with parallax, a progress bar and a counter.
contents: Intro panel, quote panel, axis panel with text and image, full-bleed image panel, hover word list, image panel, outro panel
Top progress line and bottom-right percentage counter
behavior: Vertical wheel and horizontal touch drag move the track sideways with eased smoothing
Panels are cloned so the track loops infinitely in both directions
Images and quote text drift with parallax relative to their position
Progress line and counter show position within one loop
Images shift from grayscale on hover

props.name: intro
props.default: An interactive spatial essay evaluating the friction between horizontal linear momentum and luxury digital architecture.

props.name: axisText
props.default: By detaching the text modules from fixed layout positions, characters float freely through empty space, reacting intuitively with the scrolling user.

editableByProps: All panel text, labels, word list and footer text
Scroll smoothing, touch sensitivity and clone buffer

needsCodeEdit.where: section elements inside the scrollerRef div

fixed: Root is fixed and covers the whole viewport
Captures wheel and touch events on the root with preventDefault, so page scrolling is taken over
Panel set is fixed at seven panels with their own layouts
Uses Syne, Playfair Display and Plus Jakarta Sans font families by name without importing them, so they must be loaded by the host
